section: Sometimes There Isn't a Clear Child Yet

text: Part of building who you are is untangling yourself from whatever pulls you away from your own knowing in return for belonging. A political tribe might expect consistent positions and predictable reactions, while a family or religion that’s kind to you might have expectations that just feel like being good. Most groups expect some conformity. Your family might want a particular kind of son or daughter, and your friends might have rules about what you can joke about or get upset about.
